title: Birthday Boat Trip in Madeira: How to Celebrate at Sea
description: Plan a birthday on a private boat in Madeira: which trip to pick, what is included, how food, drone and 360 video work, and tips for groups of up to 5 guests.
heroAlt: Glasses of wine raised against a Madeira sunset aboard a private boat
keywords: things to do for a birthday in Madeira
